title: Nine Millimetres of Mending
subtitle: 芯片与碎片 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 芯片与碎片（科学与技术·电子与器件）
meta: 主题语境：芯片与碎片（科学与技术·电子与器件）　|　核心词汇：chip　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chip 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 my mother was sent to mend ① chip she could not see, and she said the mending was the whole of the lesson. The ② chip, meaning the fragment and not the machine, was nine millimetres wide and was mended by whoever came last; chip, she said, is the only thing in a circuit that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ chip in that circuit had the same edge, and the ④ chip at the end, meaning the one the engineer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever mended properly. Chip, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ chip was the whole of the plate, meaning the crack it carried and not the fragment. The ⑥ chip, meaning the crack and not any of that, is the only thing in a plate that everybody notices and nobody questions; chip, he said, is either something you mend or the only word that means both a fragment and a crack. She said the crack is the part they remember.

By 1990 the ⑦ chip had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the edge. The ⑧ chip of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine millimetres and eleven years of mending; chip, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ chip I remember is the one at the end, which was mended in 1995 and is still described as the smallest in the county. A ⑩ chip, my grandmother said in 2000, is the only thing that improves by being mended; every chip, she said, is a crack that has agreed to look like a fragment. She said the crack was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 碎片（指那块碎片本身，与那台机器相对）
C. 固定搭配：mend a chip 修补一块芯片／碎片
D. n. 芯片（指那条电路上每一块）
E. n. 芯片（指末尾那一块）
F. n. 缺口（抽象：它留下的那道裂痕）
G. n. 那道裂痕（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The chip, meaning the fragment and not the machine
chip was the whole of the plate
the chip had become a number in a report
The chip of the whole thing
A chip, my grandmother said in 2000

answers.why: mend a chip 意为“修补一块芯片／碎片”，1975 年母亲被派去修补她看不见的那块芯片。
chip 意为“芯片、碎片”，指那块碎片本身而不是那台机器，宽九毫米，由最后来的人修补。
chip 指那条电路上每一块芯片，每一块都是同样的边缘。
chip 指末尾那一块（工程师保留的那一块），是唯一有人认真修补过的。
chip 意为“缺口”，抽象指它留下的那道裂痕，父亲说 chip 就是那只盘子的全部。
chip 为抽象用法，指那道裂痕本身，是一只盘子上人人都注意到、却没人质疑的东西。
chip 意为“芯片、碎片”，到 1990 年这块 chip 成了报告里的一个数字。
chip 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九毫米和十一年的修补。
chip 意为“芯片”，我记得的是末尾那一块，1995 年修补过，至今仍被说成全县最小的。
chip 为抽象总称，祖母说一块芯片是唯一会因为被认真修补而变好的东西。
